summary: Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp., a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K reporting entry into Supplement No. 1 to its October 2, 2025 Master Note Purchase Agreement, dated September 29, 2026. The company will privately place $150 million of 7.75% Series 2026A Senior Notes due October 2, 2028 with institutional purchasers under Section 4(a)(2). Interest accrues from October 15, 2026, payable semiannually each April 2 and October 2 beginning April 2, 2027; closing expected October 15, 2026. Notes are unsecured, pari passu obligations with a ratings-linked step-up of up to 200 bps.
